title: Private assembly of finite coefficient pullback
statement: For the actual finite coefficient quotient R=O_E/(varpi_E^(n+1))→S=O_E/(varpi_E^(m+1)) and a morphism f:Y→X of finite-type schemes, exact etale geometric inverse image preserves bounded constructibility and every given Tor interval [a,b] of derived R-module sheaves. The fixed scalar/pullback comparison satisfies its defining K-flat representative equation [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories, def-weil-pbc-inverse-image, def-weil-pbc-constructible-complexes, def-kun-tor-amplitude, def-pur-etale-scalar-pullback-iso, def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. This is the already proved finite pullback specialization, placed in a private implementation module.
